messages:
erin_marketing: Quick check-in  finalizing announce copy + blog bench. We need: canonical docs URL, explicit canary window, and HubSpot form + tags. Can we lock in 24h?

leo_engineering: Canary plan: 15m smoke -> 75m canary -> phased ramp. Suggested start 2026-03-31T02:00:00Z. End conditions: rollback if 5xx >1.5% for 10m or median latency +25%. Endpoints in canary: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/chat.

maya_docs: Docs PR ready at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523. If merged canonical will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-spring. I'll add a callout that model pinning is opt-in via `enable_model_pinning`.

sam_product: Merge docs before publish if possible. Add line: "Dedicated customers contact CS for assisted rollouts." Also want a one-sentence product highlight for the tweet.

jess_sales: HubSpot form URL: https://hub.redwood.ai/forms/spring-release-2026. Tags: ["spring-release-2026","bench-read"]. Will auto-add "benchmark" tag for blog referrals.

erin_marketing: Draft announce: "Launching faster, more predictable inference: cache warmups, optional model pinning, smarter batching. See changelog + docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-spring. Webinar Wed 10am PT  register." Need bench PNG for the blog hero by EOD.

leo_engineering: Perf team will export median-latency graph (per-model) and attach here by 2026-03-30 18:00 PT. Canary throttle 12rps -> ramp 48rps on success.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: smoke 2026-03-31T01:30:00Z; canary 2026-03-31T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-31T03:15:00Z; ramp 2026-03-31T04:00:00Z. Rollback thresholds as posted.

erin_marketing: Final checklist: 1) canonical docs URL (maya), 2) canary endpoints + throttle (leo), 3) HubSpot + tags (jess), 4) bench PNG (leo). If green we lock announce for 2026-03-31 15:00 PT. Ping @marketing-alert on any slip.

maya_docs: I'll merge after final proof at 2026-03-30 20:30 PT and post the canonical link here.

leo_engineering: PNG uploaded: https://files.redwood.ai/perf/spring-median-latency.png. All staging checks passed.

erin_marketing: Awesome. Locking schedule and starting social assets. Thanks everyone! :tada:
